description: Bound by chores, conflicts and criticism, Abirami, a devoted wife and mother, loses herself while keeping her family together. When life pushes her to the brink, she finds strength in her daughter and the will to reclaim her identity and dreams.

The Ethir Neechal family continues where it left off. Janani & her co-sisters are breaking down barriers to carve out their space in an exciting & empowering journey as they strive to earn their family's understanding and protect relationships. Be the first to watch your favourite serial, Ethirneechal Thodargirathu – early access only on Sun NXT.

Experience a unique cooking show packed with chef-inspired dishes, medicinal recipes, village-style cooking, and celebrity guests, all woven into exciting and unique weekly themes — with opportunities for viewers to participate too.

Akila sacrifices everything for her siblings until a betrayal forces her into an unexpected marriage, where she confronts Jaya, her husband Thamizh's manipulative sister-in-law. Can Akila's unwavering love protect her siblings and save her marriage?

Things take a momentous shift when a bold & loving village girl, Malli, crosses paths with a doting father and his 6-year-old daughter who yearns for a mother's love. Join the family's journey through the nuances of love, affection & parenthood. Malli – early access only on Sun NXT.

Poongodi rises above her father's male chauvinism, intent on proving herself & pursuing a college education. Her path crosses with Saravanan, a naïve young man who blindly trusts his manipulative stepmother. Uncover the fate of the two kindred souls.

After losing everything to her family's greed and betrayal, Parvathi finds a new home with Dharmadurai's family. As she heals a divided household scarred by feuds, fate draws the two closer in a moving tale of love and redemption.

A powerful tale of two sisters, Thulasi and Thendral, whose bond is tested by betrayal, greed, and dark intentions. United by courage and love, they rise strong to expose the truth in their battle against injustice.
